He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech Red Raiders]]. ==High school career== As a freshman and sophomore, Ramsey played basketball for [[Mansfield Summit High School]] in his hometown of [[Arlington, Texas]].{{cite web |last1=Caplan |first1=Callie |title=2019 SportsDayHS boys basketball Player of the Year: Duncanville guard Jahmius Ramsey |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/high-school-sports/2019/03/21/2019-sportsdayhs-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year-duncanville-guard-jahmius-ramsey/ |website=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |accessdate=October 9, 2019 |date=March 21, 2019}} Entering his junior season, he transferred to [[IMG Academy]], a prominent [[College-preparatory school|prep school]] in [[Bradenton, Florida]], where he played a national schedule and started drawing more college interest.{{cite web |last1=Daniels |first1=Evan |title=Jahmius Ramsey shows versatility as interest rises |url=https://247sports.com/Article/Jahmius-Ramsey-shows-versatility-as-interest-rises-112417405/ |publisher=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |accessdate=October 9, 2019 |date=December 18, 2017}} For his senior year, Ramsey moved to [[Duncanville High School]] in [[Duncanville, Texas]], after initially intending to join national powerhouse [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]].{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Cam |title=After transferring from IMG to Oak Hill, four-star Jahmius Ramsey transfers (again) to Duncanville (Texas) |url=https://usatodayhss.com/2018/after-transferring-from-img-to-oak-hill-four-star-jahmius-ramsey-transfers-again-to-duncanville-texas |website=USA Today High School Sports |accessdate=September 29, 2019 |date=September 24, 2018}} He averaged 21 points and six rebounds per game, leading his team to a Class 6A state championship. On April 20, 2019, Ramsey posted 15 points, six rebounds, and two steals at the [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{cite web |title=Apr 20, 2019 - Away 132 at Home 125 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/highschool/jordan_classic/Boxscore/2019 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=October 9, 2019 |date=April 20, 2019}} On May 4, he shared [[most valuable player]] (MVP) honors with [[Isaiah Mobley]] at the [[Ballislife All-American Game]].{{cite web |last1=Wells |first1=Adam |title=Team Elite Wins BallisLife All-American Game; Isaiah Mobley, Jahmius Ramsey MVPs |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2834696-team-elite-wins-ballislife-all-american-game-isaiah-mobley-jahmius-ramsey-mvps |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=September 29, 2019 |date=May 4, 2019}} ===Recruiting=== Ramsey was considered a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[Rivals.com]] and a four-star recruit by [[ESPN]] and [[247Sports.com]]. On November 28, 2018, he committed to play college basketball for [[Texas Tech Red Raiders men's basketball|Texas Tech]] over [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]] and many other [[NCAA Division I]] programs. Ramsey became the highest-ranked recruit in school history and its first five-star recruit.{{cite web |last1=Borzello |first1=Jeff |title=Jahmius Ramsey, No. 28 in ESPN 100, commits to Texas Tech |url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/recruiting/basketball/mens/story/_/id/25215913/texas-tech-red-raiders-get-commitment-jahmius-ramsey |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=October 9, 2019 five 3-pointers and six rebounds versus [[LIU Blackbirds men's basketball|LIU]], Ramsey was named [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] newcomer of the week on November 25, 2019.{{cite web|url=https://big12sports.com/news/2019/11/25/butler-and-ramsey-receive-mens-basketball-weekly-honors.aspx|title=Butler and Ramsey Receive Men’s Basketball Weekly Honors|publisher=Big 12 |title=Report: Jahmi’us Ramsey to miss Texas Tech’s game vs. No. 1 Louisville the conclusion of the regular season, Ramsey was named [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] Freshman of the Year and Second Team All-Conference.{{cite press release|url=https://big12sports.com/news/2020/3/7/mens-basketball-all-big-12-awards-announced.aspx|title=Men’s Basketball All-Big 12 Awards Announced|work=[[Big 12 Conference]]|date=March 8, 2020 |accessdate=March 8, 2020 |date=March 8, 2020}} Ramsey averaged 15 points, 4 rebounds, 2.2 assists and 1.3 steals per game.{{cite news |last1=Chasen |first1=Scott |title=AP awards roundup: Udoka Azubuike wins Big 12 player of the year |url=https://247sports.com/college/kansas/Article/AP-awards-roundup-Udoka-Azubuike-wins-Big-12-player-of-the-year-144855766/ |accessdate=March 24, 2020
